description: Add a prayer request to the user's prayer board. Takes a short title and the request itself; a sentence in the user's words is enough, a composed prayer is not required. Returns the prayer id. To change its status later, use update_prayer_status.

title.description: A brief title for the prayer (3-8 words). Capture the essence — e.g. 'Clarity for grace series teaching', 'Wisdom for small group tonight', 'Sarah's grief after losing her mom'.

name: save_prayer
title: Save prayer
